title: CORE-LLM-Bench: A Controlled Neurosymbolic Benchmark for Ontology-Grounded Reasoning in Large Language Models
description: CORE-LLM-Bench v1.0.0 is a controlled neurosymbolic benchmark containing 9,032 question-hop instances across Family, Pizza 100, Pizza 250, and OWL2Bench: 5,999 binary question-answering (BQA) instances and 3,033 open-ended question-answering (OEQA) instances. Each instance aligns natural-language (NL), formal-symbolic (FS), and abstract-representation (AR) conditions and records 1-hop or 2-hop ontology-context depth, explanation-complexity metadata, reasoning-type coverage, and source-ontology provenance.
